name: @vektor/edge-sync-svc
description: EDGE-005/006: a Tactical Edge Node's local sync layer — a persisted-offset Kafka consumer that delta-catches-up entity state on reconnect (not a full replay, and not relying solely on the broker's group-commit position), plus the BullMQ intake queue field-pwa's offline IndexedDB writes drain into once connectivity returns (§9.7, §11.4).
